name: Plastic Dodo 97
author: Bodyhc
description: Blue text input that reacts on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, outline becomes 2px solid #0d14e9. On focus, border-bottom becomes 3px solid #0d14e9, border-radius becomes 5px 5px 2px 2px, transform becomes scale(1.1).
html: <input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Search For AnyThink.." class="input">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Plastic Dodo 97</title>
<style>
/* Plastic Dodo 97 by Bodyhc — https://uiverse.io/Bodyhc/plastic-dodo-97 */
.input[type=text] {
  max-width: 180px;
  height: 20px;
  background-color: #fff;
  color: #242424;
  padding: .15rem .5rem;
  min-height: 40px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  outline: none;
  border: none;
  box-shadow: 0px 10px 20px -18px blue;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #0d14e9;
  transition: .10s ease;
}

.input[type=text]:hover {
  outline: 2px solid #0d14e9;
  max-width: 200px;
}

.input[type=text]:focus {
  border-bottom: 3px solid #0d14e9;
  border-radius: 5px 5px 2px 2px;
  transform: scale(1.1);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" name="search" placeholder="Search For AnyThink.." class="input">

</body>
</html>
